links.comparator_used: Original ASSH website patient education materials (unsimplified)
links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) and word count of AI-rewritten ASSH content
links.effect: AI-rewritten ASSH content had improved readability; original ASSH PEMs FRE 57.5 (6.6), FKGL 9.4 (1.2), 10th-12th grade level (all P < .001 for sixth-grade AI PEMs vs original; specific rewritten values not given in abstract)
links.tradeoff: Accuracy of AI-generated PEMs was not assessed; authors note future efforts are needed to ensure accuracy.
links.quote: Artificial intelligence-rewritten ASSH content had improved readability, and AI-generated PEMs at a sixth-grade readability had lower word counts, higher FRE, and lower FKGL than original ASSH PEMs (all P < .001).

links.comparator_used: Default AI prompt with no reading-level instruction (initial original PEMs)
links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated PEMs (FRE, FKGL) when prompted for sixth-grade level
links.effect: Initial unprompted PEMs were at college level (Gemini FRE 49.7, FKGL 9.6; ChatGPT FRE 47.4, FKGL 10.4); sixth-grade-prompted PEMs had higher FRE, lower FKGL and lower word counts than original ASSH PEMs (all P < .001)
links.tradeoff: Accuracy of AI-generated PEMs not verified; shorter word counts may reflect reduced content.
links.quote: Artificial intelligence platforms can be used as a tool to create hand surgery PEMs at the recommended sixth-grade reading level.
